pr_title: Fix follow recommendation moderation page default language when using regional variant

issue_context.title: Follow recommendations page defaults to first alphabetical language (Afrikaans)
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Navigate to the "Follow recommendations" moderation page


### Expected behaviour

List is not filtered by Afrikaans

### Actual behaviour

List is filtered by Afrikaans

### Detailed description

More sensible default would probably be: no filter selected (as in trending posts), my current user language, or the server default locale.

### Mastodon instance

sunny.garden

### Mastodon version

v4.3.0

### Browser name and version

Firefox 131.0.2

### Operating system

Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.19045.4894]

### Technical details

_No response_
comments:
I am not able to reproduce this.

According to https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/stable-4.3/app/controllers/admin/follow_recommendations_controller.rb#L28, the default value comes from a newly created `FollowRecommendationFilter`, with the HTTP `params`, which should not be set when you open the page. 

And this default language is `I18n.locale`, which should be the current user's default locale: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/stable-4.3/app/models/follow_recommendation_filter.rb#L14

Can you confirm the URL shown in the browser when you click on the link? And confirm that your locale is not currently set to Afrikaans?

> Can you confirm the URL shown in the browser when you click on the link? And confirm that your locale is not currently set to Afrikaans?

The URL is `https://sunny.garden/admin/follow_recommendations`

My "Interface language" in preferences was set to "English (British)".  I changed it to "English" and after that, the following recommendations page defaulted to "English" when opened.  Changing it back to "English (British)" defaults to Afrikaans again.

Good catch, this is the issue! There is no "English (British)" post language, so it fallbacks to the first item in the menu.

If there is no matching post language for the locale, we should probably fallback to the "base" language, and otherwise to the default language.

review_comments: How about making this method private and moving it to the bottom? It seems like a small utility method that should not be called from outside.
